description: This is a utility class providing static methods for file IO operations within the PdfSharp.Quality namespace. It includes functions for path normalization, determining project-specific directories, temporary file handling, and asset management tailored for .NET applications.

classes.name: IOUtility
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for file path operations, temporary file handling, and asset management tailored for unit tests and sample code within the PdfSharp.Quality namespace.

methods.name: IsDirectorySeparator
methods.description: Checks if a character is a directory separator ('\' or '/')

methods.name: NormalizeDirectorySeparators
methods.description: Replaces all backslashes with forward slashes in a given path string.

methods.name: GetSolutionRoot
methods.description: Traverses the directory hierarchy upward to locate the root directory containing a solution (.sln) file.

methods.name: GetAssetsPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the assets directory within the solution, optionally appending a relative path or filename.

methods.name: GetTempPath
methods.description: Provides the path to a temporary directory, creating it if necessary, optionally appending a relative directory.

methods.name: GetViewerWatchDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory used for viewer watching, hardcoded depending on operating system.

methods.name: GetTempFileName
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary filename with a specified prefix, extension, and optional info suffix.

methods.name: GetTempFullFileName
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a specified prefix, extension, and optional sub-path within the temp directory, returning its complete path.

methods.name: FindLatestTempFile
methods.description: Searches in a directory (recursively if specified) to find the most recently modified temp file matching a pattern.

methods.name: EnsureAssets
methods.description: Checks that the assets folder exists, contains required files or directories, and optionally verifies asset version.

methods.name: EnsureAssetsVersion
methods.description: Verifies that the assets folder's version meets or exceeds the specified minimum version.

methods.name: GetCachedWebFile
methods.description: Retrieves a web resource, caching it in the assets folder if not already present, downloading from the specified URL.
